To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the synthesis and anticancer activity of a series of glucosylated podophyllotoxins linked by 4β-tri-azole rings have been investigated.
a perbutyrate group on the glucose residue and the 4′-demethylation of the podophyllotoxins scaffold are crucial for the enhancement of anticancer activity.

a series of 4beta-triazole-linked glucosyl podophyllotoxins were synthesized via a click chemistry approach, and the most potent compound 35 showed significantly better anticancer activity than the drug etopisde currently in clinical use.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of a series of novel triazole-linked glucose podophillotoxin conjugates as potential anticancer agents.
the design and synthesis of novel 4β-tri-azole-linked glucose podophyllo-toxin conjugates.
the synthesis and biological evaluation of a series of novel 4β-triaole-linked glucosylated podophyllotoxins.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the introduction of glucose and the 4β-triazole ring into podophyllotoxins can enhance the potency of the antitumor activity of podophylltoxins.
the 4β-triazoled glucose podophyllotoin conjugates can be considered as potential anticancer agents.
the perbutyrylation on glucose residue is the most important factor that determines the anticancer activity, followed by the length of the oligoethylene glycyl linker.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 4β-triazolederivatives are promising candidates for the development of novel anticancer agents.
the 4β-triazolederivatives of podophylltoxin linked to glucose residue through oligoethylene glycols have been synthesized and evaluated for anticancer activity.
the 4β-triazoled glucose podophyllotin conjugates with the perbutyrylation of glucose residue are the best candidates for the development of new anticancer agents.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 4β-triazoled glucose-podophyllotoxin derivatives have good anticancers activity and are promising lead compounds for the further development of new anticancer drugs.
the 4β-triazole-linked glucose conjugation strategy is a promising approach for improving the anticancer activity of podophylltoxin derivatives.
glucose conjugated podophyllotoxins with 4β-tri-azole linker can be a new class of anticancer agents.
